svg.text: Scene: a human gate trips, organically, and the run resumes with the judgment journaled
Gates are not scripted demo moments: they open whenever a step's calibrated confidence falls below the threshold the package declares. Red marks the suspended interval.
run starts
gate opens
run resumes
run completes
1 · Steps execute and score
Each agent step grounds through the IQ
federation, reasons on gpt-4o, and gets a
calibrated confidence. Journal first,
then move on
2 · Confidence below threshold
e.g. ambiguous coverage on a step scoring
0.62 against a 0.75 gate policy. The Durable
orchestration suspends; nothing downstream
executes while a human is thinking
3 · The queue shows it live
The subject flips to "needs review" in the
operator queue in real time (SignalR tail).
Decision Mode's "Your judgment" panel holds
the step, its reasoning, and its evidence
4 · Evidence attached
Cited sources per system,
ontology entities touched,
submitted photos + the
intake vision assessment
5 · The operator judges
Approve the agent's proposal, override it with one of the
package's declared alternatives, or redirect. A rationale is
captured. The resolution posts to
POST /api/runs/{runId}/resolve-hitl
and the judgment becomes a first-class journal event
6 · The run resumes, exactly where it stopped
The orchestration continues with the human decision in
context. Downstream steps see the override output, not
the below-threshold proposal. The member tracker shows
"a specialist is reviewing" during the gate and moves on
when it clears
7 · Audit, for free
The gate, the operator identity, the rationale, and the taken
option are all journal events, so the Decision Record reprints the
whole intervention verbatim, and Outcomes counts it in the
oversight rate. Nothing about the intervention is reconstructed
from memory; it is all replayed from the immutable log
DESIGN INTENT
The platform never asks a human to rubber-stamp everything (that is theater) and never lets uncertainty through silently (that is negligence).
The package declares the threshold per use case; the runtime honors it uniformly; the journal proves it happened. A forced-gate switch exists in the
Lab page for rehearsals, and is labeled as such.
